main.description: A proposal to do a quest on specific terms, from EITHER side — a party claiming the work (any verified builder), or a patron/delegate inviting. The quest is a public advert; THIS pins the binding party, reward, and payment terms (which may differ from the advert). It becomes binding (AGREED) only under FULL per-person consent: an org.buildguild.acceptance from the patron side AND from every party[] member (the offer's author consents by authoring) — see org.buildguild.acceptance. Author is the offerer (repo owner); `role` says which side they are. Patron-side authors must be the quest author or an authorized delegate (quest.delegates / charter capability). Written to the offerer's repo.

role.description: Which side the author is — a patron inviting, or a party claiming.

party.description: Builder DIDs who would do the work (the delivering party). Pinned now so splits/attestation eligibility is fixed from agreement, not settlement.

amount.description: Optional numeric reward total in minor units (e.g. cents) — integer, never a float — so progressive settlements can be summed toward 'fully paid'. Omit for non-monetary rewards.

terms.description: Payment sequencing: 'upfront' = pay then deliver (patron at risk); 'on_delivery' = deliver then pay (party at risk).

milestones.description: Optional declared payment schedule. Omit for a single deliverable; milestones may also emerge ad hoc as delivery/settlement pairs.
